Results.ReviewText:
*Update*
After two years I finally received the replacement fuel tank. The customer service team worked really hard to get it to me this time and, since I had another mechanical issue with the off interruptor, they also sent me the whole trigger replacement under warranty. After the repairs the machine works great.

I've had this machine for some time now. I feel I need to pass some knowledge along for potential new customers. When I first bought this machine, I detected a strong smell of gas coming out of it. When inspecting it, I noticed that it had a gas leak coming from the carburetor. I contacted the manufacturer and they said that the gas tank was the issue. They offered to send a dull replacement for the gas tank, but it never came. After this, I did not hear back from the manufacturer anymore. I managed to fix the issue and the machine worked for s few more months. Yesterday I noticed a strong smell of gas coming from the machine again. Turns out the carburetor is again leaking. I went to the manufacturer's website to look for parts, and between the spare parts and shipping, it is more expensive to fix the machine than to buy a new one! I regret buying this brand. Now I will have to either buy new parts for this machine elsewhere, or get a new machine.
Results.Title: *update* Good machine, customer service took some time to respond but they fixed my issue

Results.ReviewText: Works well so far. The instructions are a bit hard to follow though.  Restringing seems easy when following the instructions, but the string comes easily unraveled after restringing according to the instructions (while using the machine when the head is spinning). I'm now using new 0.95 width string and am still playing with other methods to get the string to stay wound while using the machine.

Values.Value: POWER> HANDHELD POWER> OTHER TRIMMERS> GAS TRIMMERS

309475184.Description: The Wild Badger Power Straight Shaft 2-in-1 Grass String Trimmer and Brush Cutter is a versatile, powerful tool. This multi-tool has a grass trimmer attachment for detail work along borders and a brush cutter blade for heavier grasses and brush clearing. This tool includes a harness to relieve the strain on your arms and improve stability. The full crank engine reduces emissions, increasing fuel efficiency and delivering longer life. The transmission is supported by a vented aluminum casing which greatly reduces vibration allowing you to work in comfort until the job is done. The attachment capable straight shaft is built with a robust aluminum tube and connection point which is lightweight and durable. The tap-and-go trimmer head with easy load allows for quick line feed for the twin line cutting system. Replacing the line will no longer eat up precious daylight and will give you more time to get your lawns and landscaping looking clean. Notes about the product: This machine takes a mix of both gasoline and oil, other attachments and accessories not included.
